claim.text: GELU does not cut at zero: a negative input still leaks through, unlike a hard cutoff.

spec.explain: Illustrative toy from arXiv 1606.08415 comparing smooth GELU leakage to a hard zero cutoff; the bound is the negative-side leak condition of the topic.

questions.q: Predict what happens to the leak when x is set to -1?
Many think negative x gives exactly zero like a cutoff, but what do you expect at x = -2 before moving it?
How small is the leak compared to the cutoff when x is set to -0.5?
What shape do you see around x = 1 versus x = -1?
questions.why: contrasts regimes without asking for numbers
